## 维护者速读(补丁轮后,head `e1edc4196`)

- **改了什么**:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` 下 4 个文件、11 行改 11 行,每个文件行数不变(SKILL.md 811、contract-review.md 60、core-rules.md 150、lanes/cli.md 29),每行 ≤120 字节。强制条款②从「凡放宽接受集或扩大公开面的卡一律契约复审档」改为「默认判断档施工、契约复审档复核」;`references/**` 里五处仍写「条款②卡派/锁契约复审档施工」的句子(contract-review.md :10 :13 :15、core-rules.md :113、lanes/cli.md :18)同轮改成只定复核档;删掉两句因此失效的特例(额度耗尽豁免及于条款②;入队闸门里的「派发档位低于契约复审档」谓词);〈轮次报告与节奏〉加一行计数器。条款①、`needs:contract-review` 双载体纪律、降档保险丝、`lanes/spec.md` 分派判据、四轴框架块一字未动。
- **为什么改**:你的原话「开skill卡,在裁决落地之前,你直接按新规则试行」;架构本已把契约复审定为低档派发的补偿(`references/contract-review.md` 降档保险丝「豁免对象是派发,复核正为补偿低档派发而存在」)和 2026-08-20 的「fable 当审计师用,不当施工队用」;条款②是唯一还把贵档压在施工这条大项上的地方。施工与复审 token 量级实测 33 万 vs 21 万,档位只改单价。复审席指出 `references/**` 五处与 SKILL.md 互相矛盾,总监席把文件面扩到那三份,本轮一并改齐。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:① 主风险 = 默认档施工把公开面判错的概率是否高于达档施工,这一点**没有测量**,卡片自己的基线是 1 FAIL / 1(样本一,不是基线)。计数器因此是改动的另一半:轮报席在复审清单记默认档施工的条款②复审 FAIL 率,与改制前达档施工的历史值比;超出 ⇒ 立决策卡交你定回退,席位不自裁。② :639 入队闸门被重写后的**后果要你知情**:凡路径肢命中(diff 触 `packages/spec/src/**`)的 PR,不论申报 `Clause-②: yes` 还是 `no`、不论施工档位,入队唯一出口都是席内契约复审档的 PASS 在案 —— 比 #16912 记录的 spec 车道现行做法(`--pair` 退出 0 即入队)更严。本 PR 不裁 #16912。③ `references/contract-review.md` 同时被排队卡 #16836(未认领、无 PR)申报,其认领者需 re-merge。回滚 = revert 本 PR 两个 commit(4 文件、11 行)。
- **席位意见**:席位推荐落地。四轴:业务需求 — 派发席实测在付的钱在施工端;长远 — 把特例并进已有的「降档施工的补偿控制 = 复核席跑契约复审档」规则,且五份拷贝与主文一致;防 AI 犯错 — 闸门只收紧不放松,清标仍只由达档裁决完成,错误由复审拦而不是靠施工档位;创业聚焦 — 不加脚本、不加标签、不加状态,只加一行计数。
- **你要做的**:读 PR 正文里 11 行的 before/after 与「每条删行的内容现在住哪」;确认上面 ② 的闸门后果是你要的(不是 ⇒ :639 需插「判定 `yes`」,回补丁轮);同意则 approve + 人工直合;不同意直接关 PR,文本无副作用。此 PR 是 强制条款① 面(SKILL.md 主文件),已按契约复审档施工,改动不豁免自身落地。

### Per-line reading (merge-base `0939ba008` → head `bd26a0839`)

| line | old | new | faithful narrowing? | content lost? |

No conflict with the exemption floor :526 「仅当契约复审档实测不可用才落默认判断档,⛔ 不再往下」 (build tier now equals the floor) nor with `contract-review.md:60` (review never downgrades; unchanged). |

| :522 | 卡面对条款②的复述仍是条款②;额度耗尽豁免及其 `needs:contract-review` 补偿一并及于它。 | *(deleted)* | n/a | no. First half → :517. Every guarantee has a home. |

The tier predicate is dead under :514 (every clause-② build is below the ceiling, so the old line would read "never enqueue"). The new predicate 「PASS 在案」 is defined at `contract-review.md:41` 落地前检① 「席内契约档 PASS 在案,即卡上的达档裁决评论」. | the tier bar is dropped deliberately (it is what the PR changes); no other content lost |

### Gate readings (extracted tree of `bd26a0839`, dependency-free scripts run by this seat)

- `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` → exit 0, `SKILL.md is 811 lines (ceiling 811; headroom 0)`. Re-measured: 811 lines; changed lines 514/517/524/639/675 are 108 / 97 / 79 / 118 / **120** bytes (:675 is exactly at the 120-byte budget).

Substituted: frame block :734-752 md5 `22f2339f0acb64cdb50c7adc9db681c3` on merge-base, on head, **and on current `origin/main` `70f7d6d73`** — identical all three.
- Diff vs merge-base: exactly one file; `origin/main` since the merge-base does not touch `.claude/skills/**`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` or `AGENTS.md`.
- Commit `bd26a0839` trailers: `Co-Authored-By` + `Claude-Session` only — no closing keyword / `Part-of` / `Refs` bound to a card (RULE 2 of `scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs`); CI check `Part-of PR must not also close its card` green.
- Four governed pieces: `draft: true` ✓ · labels `needs-user-decision` + `skip-changeset` (+ `documentation`, `size/s`) ✓ · 速读 comment 5588349195 ✓ · reviewers `hotlong`, `os-zhuang` ✓. `mergeable_state: blocked` (draft + required review — expected).
- CI (`get_check_runs`, 32 runs): polled once at 16:28Z — 30 of 32 completed (16 `success`, 14 `skipped`, 0 failures); **2 still `in_progress` at 16:28Z**: `Lint & Repo Gates` (job 102142928896) and `Type Check · workspace` (job 102142928428), both started 16:19Z. Not a green reading; the director seat re-reads CI before recording. This diff is markdown-only, outside eslint's `files` population, so neither job's verdict can vary with it.

### Findings

1. **[major] The protocol still contradicts itself on the clause-② build tier inside `references/**`, and none of it is in #16914.** After this PR, `SKILL.md:514` says default-tier build, while on the same head:
   - `references/contract-review.md:10` 「`Clause-②: yes | no` 按设计临时:只定派发档位的保守方向」 — the declaration's stated purpose is to set the *dispatch* tier, which it no longer does;
   - `references/contract-review.md:13` 「新导出符号或已发布载荷上的新键恒 `yes`,直接锁契约复审档」 — a claim-time lock of the ceiling for the build;
   - `references/contract-review.md:15` 「claim 拿不准 ⇒ 按 `yes` 派契约复审档」 — an explicit instruction to *dispatch* at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`;
   - `references/core-rules.md:113` 「派发调用 … 协议语义面与契约变更卡恒走契约复审档」 — an explicit dispatch mandate for contract-change cards;
   - `references/lanes/cli.md:18` 「条款②从卡内容判且优先于它」 — clause ② overriding the path-derived tier floor only makes sense if clause ② sets a build tier.

   #16914 exists and covers exactly what its body lists: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` prose (three sites) and `core-rules.md:124`. It does not cover the five lines above, and the PR body's "Untouched" paragraph presents `references/contract-review.md` as consistent with the change (「the tier fuse … untouched」) without disclosing that :13/:15 of the same file mandate the opposite build tier. The claim fenced `contract-review.md` out of the file surface unless the counter lived there, so the dev could not edit it — but the claim also says 「stop on breach; explain in the report」, and the report explains neither. A PM reading `contract-review.md:15` after this lands is told to dispatch at the ceiling; one reading `SKILL.md:514` is told not to.
   *Expectation:* either (a) the director widens the surface and this PR rewrites those five lines in place — all five can be reworded line-neutrally (e.g. :15 「claim 拿不准 ⇒ 按 `yes` 挂标走契约复审档复核」, :13 「…恒 `yes`,直接锁契约复审档复核」, core-rules :113 「协议语义面卡恒走契约复审档,契约变更卡恒过契约复审档复核」), so the ratchet (contract-review.md 60/60, core-rules.md 150/150, cli.md 29/29) is not disturbed; or (b) the maintainer accepts the interim contradiction explicitly, in which case #16914 must be widened to name these five sites and the PR body's "Untouched" paragraph must disclose them. (a) is the smaller total change; the choice is the maintainer's.

2. **[minor] :639 — direction of the gate change is not "outcome unchanged" as the body says; it is the stricter of #16912's two readings and stricter than #16912's own proposal.** Old text, literal (Reading A of #16912): any path-limb hit + below-ceiling dispatch ⇒ hard bar, no exit. Old text as the instrument reads it (Reading B): the diff is adjudicated, any tier can pass. New text: any limb hit ⇒ an in-seat `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS on record is the *only* exit, regardless of tier. Consequences: (i) for an at-tier build the gate line itself now demands a PASS, where before only :643 / 落地前检① did — narrowing; (ii) for a below-tier build the absolute bar becomes a PASS requirement — the only reading compatible with :514, and it removes the lane freeze #16912 reports; (iii) for a `Clause-②: no` PR whose diff merely touches `packages/spec/src/**` (path limb), a PASS is now required — #16912 records that #16899 / #16901 were enqueued on `--pair` exit 0 *without* a PASS, and #16912's suggested wording would only bar a `yes` verdict below tier. `lanes/spec.md:33` 「条款②路径肢照命中,入队前仍过契约复核」 already states (iii) for the pre-approved ledger class, so the new line is consistent with the lane's own rule and with 「按更严的一条行动」 — defensible; but the 速读 tells the maintainer 「闸门不变」, which is only true against Reading A + :643. So #16912 describes exactly this ambiguity and this line resolves it. Not deciding #16912 here.
   *Expectation:* the 速读 / PR body says in one sentence that every path-limb hit now needs an at-tier PASS to enqueue, including `Clause-②: no` spec-lane PRs, so the maintainer rules on that knowingly; if that is not intended, :639 needs 「判定 `yes`」 inserted before the PASS clause (fits the 120-byte budget only with compression).

3. **[minor] :675 — the recording half is executable, the revert half is not.** Who/where/when: the round-report writer, in the 复审清单 section that `contract-review.md:40` does define (「轮次报告设复审清单专节,形状与代裁清单同为强制审计」), every round — fine. But 「实质高于达档施工 ⇒ 条款②回退」 names no actor, no threshold, and its comparison arm 「达档施工」 is produced by nothing in the rule once every clause-② card builds at the default tier: the at-tier sample stays at the historical 1/1 unless a PM keeps exercising :508 「按卡取用」 discretion. 「基线待测」 admits this but does not say who will measure it. The revert itself is a governed-text change, so the seat's only executable action is to escalate — the line does not say so.
   *Expectation:* non-blocking. Acceptable as-is if the maintainer treats the counter as a report line that feeds a human decision; otherwise the line should name the escalation (决策箱) as the trigger's output.

4. **[info, non-blocking] PR body carries two attribution footers** (a bare footer, then `---` + footer, appended by the platform on create). AGENTS.md:432 「⛔ never re-send a body that already carries an appended footer」 — correctly left alone.

5. **[info] Process.** The freshness gate cannot be run meaningfully outside a git checkout; the md5 substitute above is the reading. The dev's claim recorded `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` for the build, as 条款① requires for this file; this seat did not verify the transcript (`contract-review.md:56`) — that reading belongs to the dispatching seat.

**Maintainer-only merge: yes**
